title: AXI4 WLAST Count Mismatch
description: AWLEN=3 declares four write-data transfers; inspect the accepted beats to catch WLAST asserted on beat 3 and missing on the required final beat.

annotations.message: The AW handshake declares AWLEN=3, so exactly four W transfers belong to this burst.
D0 is accepted as beat 1 of 4. WLAST correctly remains LOW.
D1 is accepted as beat 2 of 4. The receiver's accepted-beat count advances only on WVALID && WREADY.
Protocol error: WLAST is HIGH on beat 3 even though AWLEN requires a fourth transfer. AXI does not support early burst termination.
Protocol error: the required fourth transfer is accepted with WLAST LOW. Receiver behavior after these violations is implementation-dependent; the monitor must flag the first mismatching edge.

violations.message: WLAST asserted before accepted beat count reached AWLEN+1.
WLAST missing on the accepted final beat declared by AWLEN.
